## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `25b8b6eeb26946ef72aeb396a6643d6e29f6da47`

Inputs: card #9528 (body and both comments — the PM claim comment and the `os-dev-report`), PR #10970 (body, file list, net diff against `main` at the head), and the head's check-runs. Every revision cited below was read with `git show` / `git log` on the sibling checkout; nothing was built, run or re-run, and no other thread was consulted.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set / public surface: nothing moves — right.** The net diff against `main` is one file, `.changeset/6286-explain-batch-cap-from-spec.md`, +3 / −2, prose only. No source, export, schema, test or gate is touched; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green and the path is not a governed surface.
- **Frontmatter byte-identical to the base — right.** `'@object-ui/plugin-grid': patch` on both sides: the first four lines of the file at the PR base `328abeb553` and at the head compare equal, and the file is identical at `origin/main`, at `328abeb553` and at `b120b66077` (the branch point, `25b8b6eeb2^`).
- **Provenance of the changeset — right.** `c38162d7c9` (#6333, 2026-08-25) is the ONLY commit that ever touched the file (`git log --diff-filter=A` and the full `git log` on the path agree), so 「when this change landed」 names exactly one revision.
- **Claim 1 of the rewritten sentence — the export filter existed in BOTH scanners when the changeset landed — TRUE.** At `c38162d7c9` the gate `scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` holds `if (!hasExportModifier(stmt)) continue;` exactly twice: once inside `export function scanFileForClaims` (rule 2) and once inside `function scanFile` (rule 1). `9207c53e45^` reads the same: 2 filter lines, 1 helper definition, 0 `No export filter` comments.
- **Claim 2 — objectui#6291 has since removed that filter from both scanners — TRUE.** At `9207c53e45` (#7274, 2026-09-02) the filter line occurs 0 times and the two `// No export filter` comments sit in the same two functions (`scanFileForClaims`, `scanFile`); the `hasExportModifier` helper is still defined there but has no call site (its only other mentions are two header lines). The commit message names the ruling twice: 「Half 1 of the split ruled on objectui#6291」 and 「Half 2 of the split ruled on objectui#6291」. Ancestry: `c38162d7c9` is an ancestor of `9207c53e45`, the reverse is not, and `9207c53e45` is an ancestor of the PR base — so the old sentence was true when written and became false at `9207c53e45`, which is what the PR body claims and what the new sentence records. On the base the helper is gone (0 definitions) and the gate's own header reads 「HISTORY, NOT BEHAVIOUR. Neither scanner has an export filter today」; the rewritten sentence agrees with it.
- **Does the sentence still say why the gate could not catch that const — yes.** It keeps both halves of the cause (the scanners skipped non-exported declarations; the const was module-local, objectui#5899), dates them to the landing, and records the removal. It asserts no live capability of the gate, so a later gate change cannot falsify it the way `9207c53e45` falsified the old wording (objectui AGENTS.md #9). One precision remark, not a defect: the dev's own 2×2 probe shows rule 2 never reports this const in any cell (`findClaim` returns null on its doc comment), so the filter was the operative cause for rule 1 only; the sentence does not claim otherwise.
- **The REST of the body, read at the head — no false statement; one dated one, carried to ③.** Checked on the head or in the objectstack sibling: the hook imports `EXPLAIN_BATCH_MAX_RECORD_IDS` from `@objectstack/spec/security` and chunks by it; the pre-change hook at `c38162d7c9^` carried `const EXPLAIN_BATCH_MAX_RECORD_IDS = 200;` under a comment naming `17.0.0-rc.6` and `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`; the rc→17.0.0 pin bump is `7484f7f0a8` (#4953, 2026-08-17, before the changeset landed, so 「It has.」 holds); the spec source exports `EXPLAIN_BATCH_MAX_RECORD_IDS = 200` and its TSDoc says an over-cap batch is refused at validation with HTTP 400 and never truncated, while the rest package's envelope test pins `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` for a request failing `ExplainRequestSchema`; both named tests exist at the head (`useRecordCrudVerdicts.batchCap.test.tsx` stubs the spec module through `vi.mock` and captures the real cap as its control; `rowRecordCrudVerdict.test.tsx` imports the export and binds its cap to it — its only literal `200` is an HTTP status); the kept half of the comment sits on the import at the head. The tarball reading (rc.6 lacks the export, 17.0.0 / 17.1.0 / 17.2.0 carry it) is a measurement of immutable artefacts and was not re-taken.
  - **Dated, not false:** 「`@objectstack/spec@17.0.0` — the minimum `^17.0.0` admits」. `^17.0.0` was plugin-grid's declared range at `c38162d7c9`; `e2b38267da` (#10878, 2026-09-28, already on the dev's base `b120b66077`) moved it to `^17.4.0`. The fact the sentence asserts — 17.0.0 exports the symbol, so no range had to move for this change — stands, and today's floor carries the symbol too, so no upgrading reader is misdirected. It is outside the card's one-sentence scope and does not hold this PR.

### ② Semver level

- Frontmatter unchanged at `'@object-ui/plugin-grid': patch` — right for what the ORIGINAL change publishes (an import replacing a value-equal local const; no value, no behaviour, no surface change), and this PR publishes nothing of its own: a `.changeset/*.md`-only diff owes no changeset (`Changeset Declaration` green), declares no `major` (`Changeset Bump Policy` green), and `@object-ui/plugin-grid` is in the `fixed` group of `.changeset/config.json`, so `patch` is a valid level for it.
- The PR body's `Clause-②` declaration — value `no`, followed by the reasoning 「release-note prose; no contract, accept set or public surface changes …」, and identical on the card's claim comment — is a line-initial fixed key named once, a value token `no`, no parenthetical arm, not a quoted-and-continued span: under `clause2-line.mjs` it reads declared / `no` / arm null. Well-formed, and right: nothing widens or narrows.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: the dev declared none — nothing to answer.
- Dev deviation 1 (commit trailers are the model-free pair; PR footer is the session-URL form): both are the forms AGENTS.md prescribes for those surfaces, and the harness reminder's model-named trailer is the documented exemption — no action.
- Dev deviation 2 (the local test set widened from 「reads `.changeset/`」 to 「mentions `.changeset`」, 24 files): a superset of the adjudicated reader — no action; the head's Test shards are the gate of record.
- Dev acceptance note (one `fatal: Invalid symmetric difference expression` stderr line naming an all-zero sha during the local run, every test passing): a local-run artefact, not a property of this diff; the check-runs on the head decide — not escalated.
- Dev out-of-scope note — `.changeset/spec-symbol-mirrors-app-shell-7265.md` says 「held six declarations … Four are now bound … and three were renamed」, 4 + 3 against six. **Real contradiction, confirmed:** its commit `14a1b92035` (#9465) removed six names from `DEBT` (`AdminScope`, `AppLike`, `FlowEdge`, `FlowRuntimeState`, `ObjectLike`, `RemoteTable`) and the same commit's ledger comment says 「six names, seven sites」 — `ObjectLike` is both bound (`Pick`ed down in `useTrackRouteAsRecent`) and renamed (in `deriveRelatedLists`, to `MergedObjectLike`). 「Six declarations」 should read six names / seven declarations. **It publishes nothing:** its frontmatter is empty (`---` immediately followed by `---`), so the sentence never reaches a CHANGELOG. ⛔ Not fixed here — another card's body, and this seat is read-only. Left to the adopting seat to file or leave.
- The dated `^17.0.0` sentence from ①: not the card's sentence, not false, publishes as the history of that change. Escalated to the adopting seat as a possible one-sentence follow-up of the same class as #9528, lower stakes; it does not hold this PR.
- Ordering the PR body itself flags: the release PR objectui#5400 regenerates from `main` and deletes this file at publication, so the correction only lands if this PR merges first. Not verified here (that PR is outside this brief's inputs); the adopting seat orders the landing.

**Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-09-28T12:11Z** (their conclusions are the gate verdicts): 41 runs, 38 completed `success`, 3 completed `skipped` (`Test (coverage)`, `dependabot`, and the coverage-shard matrix entry whose name is the workflow's own unexpanded placeholder), 0 failures, 0 still running. Nine were in progress at the first read (the eight `Test (shard N/8)` runs and `Spec Main Shape Gate`) and were waited on in the foreground until they completed — all `success`. `Lint`, `Type Check`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Control Byte Scan` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are all `success`.
